page: Microsoft Azure E128ds_v7 is an Edsv7-family virtual machine configured with 128 vCPUs and 64 physical cores on a dedicated Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor. Operating on the x86_64 architecture under Microsoft Hyper-V, this server features a 480 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions. It is equipped with 1024.0 GB of RAM, yielding 8.0 GB of memory per core, and includes 7559 GB of local SSD storage.

In benchmark evaluations, the E128ds_v7 exhibits top-tier multi-core performance, scoring 144593.74 in stress-ng multi-core tests and 132394.2 in PassMark CPU tests. Its memory subsystem delivers high throughput, with uncached read bandwidth reaching 655.3 GB/sec and write bandwidth at 253.51 GB/sec. Database operations are highly efficient, as evidenced by a top-tier PassMark database score of 33918.49 and Redis SET performance of 209.67 million operations per second. Single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core scoring in the average tier.

Given its high memory density and substantial local storage capacity, the instance provides strong qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require dedicated GPU acceleration. The lack of a GPU limits its utility for heavy LLM text generation, where it achieves average speeds, though its prompt processing capabilities remain strong. The server is highly suited for large-scale relational databases, in-memory caching layers like Redis, data warehousing, and enterprise resource planning applications.
